card.name: Samba de Gafieira
card.tagline: Rio's elegant ballroom partner samba, the 'Brazilian tango'.
card.profile: Samba de Gafieira is a Brazilian ballroom partner dance (danca de salao) that emerged in 1940s Rio de Janeiro in working-class dance halls called gafieiras. Evolving from maxixe and later absorbing Argentine tango influence, it features the passo basico, saida lateral, leg adornments and (in performance) acrobatic figures. A unified teaching syllabus was agreed by Rio teachers in 2001 (English Wikipedia; Atomic Ballroom).
card.insight: Distinct from international ballroom Samba, it is sometimes called the 'Brazilian tango'; danced to samba, choro, pagode and other rhythms (English Wikipedia).
